content: प्रलापः .²1 Talk, conversation, discourse. .²2 Prating, prattling, an incoherent or nonsensical talk; <ls>Ms. 12. 6</ls>. .²3 An unjustified statement, non-sensical statement; न शक्यं नित्येनोपकर्तुम् . तेन नित्यमुपकुर्यादिति वचमं प्रलापः एव <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 4. 12</ls>. .²4 Lamentation, wailing; उत्तराप्रालापोपजनितकृपो भगवान् वासुदेवः <ls>K. 175</ls>; <ls>Ve. 5. 30</ls>; <ls>U. 3. 29</ls>; <ls>Rām. 1. 3. 22</ls>.
